title: Smp Report Re Boris Bomze, Suspected Soviet Agent

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. No. D 48607
Special Branch / S.2. Section 70
REPORT
Date May 10, 1933.
Subject (in full) Boris Bomze, Suspected Soviet Agent.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by
Information has been received that one Boris Bomze,
residing at Room 318 Astor House, is identical with a certain
Bomze, Italian, who is suspected of being concerned in the
kidnapping of General A.P.Kutepoff, the head of the Russian
General Military Union, which took place in Paris in 1930. The
accusation against Bomze was made by one A. Simanovitch, former
secretary to the notorious Rasputin, and was published recently
in the Russian newspapers in Paris.
Enquiries show that Boris Bomze arrived in Shanghai
from Venice on February 3, 1933, by the s.s. "Gange". He is a
Rumanian subject of Russian-Jewish origin, 53 years of age, native
of Odessa, South Russia. He holds Rumanian passport No. 010194/44
issued on January 1, 1933, by the Rumanian Consulate in Rome which
bears a visa issued by the Chinese Legation of that city on the
same date. He states that his home address is 42 Via Settenitre(?)
Genoa, Italy, and gives the "China Trade Service Corporation", 75
Nanking Road, as a reference. His luggage upon arrival consisted
of five trunks.
During the course of casual conversations with certain
persons since his arrival Bomze openly expresses being pro-Soviet
and maintains that the U.S.S.R. will ultimately become one of the
most powerful countries in the world. Other nations, he contends,
are on the road to ruin. He also mentioned that he had done
some successful business with the U.S.S.R. and that on one occasion
a vessel chartered by him transported a quantity of cargo to a
port on the Caucasian coast. He is loud in his praises concerning
the manner in which the Soviet Authorities were furthering their
trade.
Bomze has already given several parties at the Astor

报告
日期：1933年5月10日。
主题（全称）：鲍里斯·博姆泽（Boris Bomze），疑似苏联特工。
制作人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky） 转呈人：
据获情报，现居住于礼查饭店（Astor House）318室的鲍里斯·博姆泽，与某位意大利籍博姆泽系同一人，后者涉嫌参与1930年发生于巴黎的俄罗斯全军联盟（Russian General Military Union）主席 A.P. 库捷波夫将军（General A.P. Kutepoff）绑架案。对博姆泽的指控由拉斯普京（Rasputin）的前秘书 A. 西马诺维奇（A. Simanovitch）提出，并近期刊登于巴黎的俄文报纸上。
经查，鲍里斯·博姆泽于1933年2月3日乘“恒河”号轮船（s.s. "Gange"）从威尼斯抵达上海。他是罗马尼亚籍臣民，俄裔犹太人，53岁，原籍南俄敖德萨。他持有罗马尼亚护照，号码为 010194/44，由罗马尼亚驻罗马领事馆于1933年1月1日签发，该护照上贴有同日由中国驻该市公使馆签发的签证。他声称其家庭住址为意大利热那亚 Via Settenitre(?) 42号，并提供南京路75号“中国贸易服务公司”（China Trade Service Corporation）作为担保人。他抵达时的行李包括五个大皮箱。
自抵达以来，在与某些人的闲谈中，博姆泽公开表达亲苏立场，并坚称苏联最终将成为世界上最强大的国家之一。他声称，其他国家正走向毁灭。他还提到，他曾与苏联做过一些成功的生意，有一次，他租用的一艘船只将一批货物运往高加索海岸的一个港口。他大声赞扬苏联当局促进贸易的方式。
博姆泽已在礼查饭店举办过数次聚会，

House which were largely attended by Russian Jews. Through
the medium of a Russian (name unknown) employee of the Astor
House he made the acquaintance of A. Iohvidoff, a suspected
Soviet agent, who is the proprietor of the Export-Import Firm
at No.12 Rue du Consulat.
The object of his coming to Shanghai is believed to
be the disposal of a large cargo of lemons (40,000 cases) which
arrived in Shanghai from Italy on February 25, 1933, on board
the s.s. "Francesco Vazzano" - a vessel chartered by an Italian
lemon exporter in company with Bomze. This vessel is at present
anchored in mid stream in No.11 section, Whangpoo River. It is
reported that Bomze had some trouble with the Customs Authorities
over the cargo but this matter has been smoothed over somehow.
It is also reported that being unable to dispose of such a large
quantity of lemons immediately, he obtained a substantial loan
from the local Spanish Fathers in order to pay the charter money
and the crew's salary.
Bomze is frequently visited by the Italian Captain of
the s.s. "Francesco Vazzano" and by a Russian named Nikolas
Sergeeff who arrived as a passenger on board this ship and who
is believed to be Bomze's business assistant. N. Sergeeff is
a French citizen of Russian origin, 59 years of age, native of
Petrograd, mercantile marine captain by profession. He holds
French passport No.53602 issued by Prefecture de Police at Paris.
His home address is Bar Shakespear Nice, France. Another
passenger who also arrived in the same ship is one Faustino
Ferrero, 38 years of age, Italian, native of Milan. He holds
an Italian passport No.A-37465 issued on June 12, 1929.

（批：JR / Jilgns / MAY 11 1933）
Officer i/c Special Branch.
（签名：G Tchekemshansky）
D. S.

出席者多为俄裔犹太人。通过礼查饭店一名俄籍雇员（姓名不详）的介绍，他结识了 A. 约维多夫（A. Iohvidoff），此人为疑似苏联特工，也是领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）12号进出口商行的业主。
据信，他来到上海的目的是处理一批大量柠檬货物（40,000箱），该批货物于1933年2月25日由“弗朗切斯科·瓦扎诺”号轮船（s.s. "Francesco Vazzano"）从意大利运抵上海——该船是由一家意大利柠檬出口商与博姆泽合伙租用的。该船目前锚泊在黄浦江第11段江心。据报道，博姆泽在该批货物上与海关当局发生了一些纠纷，但此事不知何故已得到平息。另有报告称，由于无法立即处置如此大量的柠檬，他向当地的西班牙神父借了一笔巨额贷款，以支付租船费和船员工资。
“弗朗切斯科·瓦扎诺”号的意大利籍船长以及一名名叫尼古拉斯·谢尔盖耶夫（Nikolas Sergeeff）的俄国人经常拜访博姆泽，后者是作为乘客随该船抵达的，被认为是博姆泽的商业助手。N. 谢尔盖耶夫是法籍公民，俄裔，59岁，原籍彼得格勒，职业为商船船长。他持有法国护照，号码为53602，由巴黎警察局（Prefecture de Police）签发。他的家庭住址是法国尼斯 Bar Shakespear。同船抵达的另一名乘客是福斯蒂诺·费雷罗（Faustino Ferrero），38岁，意大利人，原籍米兰。他持有意大利护照，号码为 A-37465，签发于1929年6月12日。

（批注：JR / Jilgns / 1933年5月11日）
特别处主管警官。
（签名：G Tchekemshansky）
D. S.
